name: Project Aphotic
source:
Lucien awakens from a coma, his mind a blank slate. Guided by a young man named Hugh, he learns he's a research assistant at Lab Azura, a private facility on a secluded island. Despite the memory loss, Lucien senses a unique connection to Hugh. Living on the island, Ceto, a volunteer in research, seems to harbor secrets about Lucien's mysterious 'coma event.'

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2683320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
卢西安从昏迷中醒来，脑海中一片空白。在名叫休的青年引导下，他得知自己是孤岛私人研究机构“蔚蓝研究所”的一名研究助理。尽管失去了记忆，卢西安仍隐约感到自己与休之间有着某种独特的联系。与此同时，同住在岛上的研究志愿者刻托，似乎隐瞒着关于卢西安那场神秘“昏迷事件”的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2683320/]Steam[/url]]
